narrative.overview:
A dense, dark-first product UI where every panel is extruded from one ground like a matte tool on a bench, and a single amber light marks the thing you can act on. Built for Administrators and Experts as equals; a working surface first.

Depth is relief: a dark and a light shadow make a surface read as lifted or pressed. Governed by manuals/adr-neumorphic-reskin.md. Light mode is an equal citizen on a grey ground.

Honesty is visible: measurable boundaries under the relief, evidence and inferred badges as tags, degraded states that look like states.
keyCharacteristics: Dark first (blued near-black), light mode equal, no white surface.
Relief Depth: two levels of shadow, then flat fill and hairline.
Amber on the primary action only; everything else neutral chrome.
Plus Jakarta Sans 800 headings, DM Sans body, JetBrains Mono for eyebrows, table heads and tags.
14px base, size small everywhere, tabular numerals.
Contrast and relief asserted in tests, not eyeballed.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the primary action and selection only. Outlined and text primary buttons render as neutral chrome; an accent that is everywhere means nothing.

rules.name: The Measured Edge Rule
rules.body: A shadow edge has nothing to measure (WCAG 1.4.11). Every control keeps a real outline line under its relief.

rules.name: The Readable Step Rule
rules.body: In light mode, role colour used as text or boundary takes the dark step, never main.

rules.name: The Mono Is A Role Rule
rules.body: Mono is for eyebrows, table heads, tags and numerals, never body prose.

rules.name: The Two Levels Rule
rules.body: One thing lifted, one thing pressed into it, nothing deeper. A third level is a flat fill and a hairline.

rules.name: The Printed Flat Rule
rules.body: At print media every box-shadow is none !important.

dos: Do express tokens through MUI palette roles (background.paper, divider, text.secondary); never a token name in a component.
Do put a look needed twice in components.ts; sx is for spacing and layout.
Do keep a measurable boundary on every control and assert contrast on tokens and rendered composites.
Do use the pinned vocabulary (Expert, Roster, Bench, Job, Administrator) in all labels.
Do show degraded and inferred states as plain tags or notes, with evidence visible.
donts: Don't add a third relief level or inset-inside-inset.
Don't put amber on secondary actions or use #F59E0B as text or a boundary in light mode.
Don't introduce a white surface in either mode.
Don't rename or silently add data-testids or the frozen accessible names (web/src/frozenHooks.test.ts, spa-design-system §9).
Don't use React Context for theme or session; use useSyncExternalStore modules.
Don't set a bare borderColor on a Paper: MuiPaper resets the border to 0, so it draws nothing. Pair it with border: 1.

Don't expect extra relief inside the agents dock: the dock is already a Float Paper, so Papers within it are flat by the Two Levels Rule. Weight there comes from position, the accent edge and the button.
Don't set mono in body prose or shout labels with uppercase buttons.
Don't fabricate customers, testimonials or Expert data in mocks.
